Meta.title: YourHEI — find your school, college or university
Meta.description: A map and a personal match of universities, colleges and schools in Europe, Asia, the Americas, Oceania, the Caucasus and Central Asia.

Footer.tagline: Find where to study: universities, colleges and schools on one map, with matches that explain themselves.

why.title: Why YourHEI
why.f1Text: Universities, colleges and schools across Europe, Asia, the Americas, Oceania and the Caucasus, on one map.
why.f2Text: Every result shows why it fits and what you still need, for example a higher language score.
why.f3Text: Prices, requirements and deadlines come from official sites, with a link and the date we checked.

about.title: About the project
about.body: YourHEI helps applicants and their families choose where to study: an interactive map of universities, colleges and schools, a short survey about your goals, results and budget, and matches that explain why they fit. The service is free for applicants.

contact.title: Contact & support
contact.body: Questions about the service, corrections to an institution's page, or about your personal data? Write to us.

privacy.s1Text: YourHEI is a service that helps applicants choose where to study. This policy explains what data we collect and how we use it. By using the site you agree to it.
privacy.s2Text: Account data (e-mail and a protected form of your password); profile data (date of birth, gender if you give it, country of residence, citizenships, what you are looking for, the status of your documents); your survey answers; and technical and usage data (pages you visit, actions on the site, device, browser, language, IP address, approximate location, the site you came from), including through cookies and similar technologies.
privacy.s3Text: To run and improve the service, check the minimum age, build your matches, communicate with you, measure how the site is used, show advertising, do research, keep the service secure and meet legal duties.
privacy.s4Text: We may use analytics and advertising tools. We may send analytics and usage data, and other data we collect, to analytics, advertising, hosting and other providers and partners, wherever they are located, including in other countries.
privacy.s5Title: How we may use the data
privacy.s5Text: To the extent the law allows, we may use the data we collect as we see fit: to run, personalise, analyse and improve the service, to develop new products and services, to advertise, and to publish or share statistics and research, including in aggregated or anonymised form.
privacy.s6Text: Data is stored with our providers (for example our database provider) until you delete your account. Technical logs and backups may be kept for some time after that.
privacy.s7Text: In your profile you can edit your data, download a copy, switch off e-mails and delete your account with all data. Where the law gives you more rights, for example in the EU, the EEA or the UK, we respect them.
privacy.s8Text: We register people only from the minimum age of their country of residence (14, 16 or 18, depending on the country). If you are younger, no account is created and nothing you typed is stored.
privacy.s9Text: We use cookies and similar technologies for your language, theme and sign-in, and for analytics and advertising. Where the law requires it, we ask for your consent first.
privacy.s10Text: We may change this policy. The date at the top shows the latest version; if you keep using the site after a change, you accept the new version.

terms.s1Text: YourHEI shows educational institutions on a map and suggests options based on your answers. It is free for applicants.
terms.s2Text: Give true information and keep your password secret. One person, one account. You must have reached the minimum age of your country of residence.
terms.s3Text: Data about institutions comes from open and official sources and may be outdated or incomplete. Always check the official website before you apply. A suggestion is not a promise of admission.
terms.s4Text: Do not misuse the service: no automated mass collection of data, no attempts to break it, no false reports.
terms.s5Text: By using the service you agree that we may collect analytics and usage data, send it to any third parties we choose, wherever they are, and use all the data we collect in any way we see fit, as described in the Privacy policy, to the extent the law allows.
terms.s6Text: The site shows advertising and may link to third-party sites. We are not responsible for their content or their offers.
terms.s7Text: We may change the service and these terms; if you keep using the service after a change, you accept it. You can delete your account at any time.
terms.s8Text: The service is provided as it is, without guarantees, and we are not liable for losses from using it, to the extent the law allows.

riasec.intro: Rate each statement from 1 to 5. There are no right or wrong answers.

items.0: I like to fix or build things with my hands or tools.
items.1: I like to figure out how something works by experimenting or analysing data.
items.2: I like to create something original: write, draw, design or compose.
items.3: I like to help, teach or take care of other people.
items.4: I like to lead a team or persuade others to follow my idea.
items.5: I like to organise information, keep records and follow clear procedures.
items.6: I enjoy working outdoors, with machines, animals or plants.
items.7: I enjoy solving a hard puzzle or a maths problem.
items.8: I like to express ideas through music, theatre or visual media.
items.9: I am good at listening to people and supporting them in hard times.
items.10: I like to start a project or a business and take risks.
items.11: I like to plan budgets, schedules and details so that everything runs exactly right.
